purpose: Calibration experiment: Astra chooses points, SAM3 draws boundaries, Astra inspects and corrects. Not autonomous accuracy evaluation.

targets.description: Central short blade beside main stem
Down-right blade within dense lower-left foliage; tentative anchor

criteria: Tips and boundary alignment inspected against original pixels
No reward for number of fragments
All ambiguous candidates and failed corrections retained
limits: At most two corrective rounds after initial comparison. No more than four additional points per target. No true IoU or percentage-accuracy claim without independent reference labels. Enlarging uses bicubic interpolation, not generated detail.
